name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Row
steps: Take a staggered stance with the foot opposite the kettlebell forward and hinge at your hips.
Rest your free forearm on your front thigh and let the kettlebell hang below your other shoulder.
Pull the kettlebell back toward your hip by driving your elbow close to your ribs and squeezing your lat and upper back.
Lower the bell smoothly back to full arm extension, and switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep your shoulders square to the floor rather than rotating your torso to lift the weight.
Maintain a neutral spine and pull toward your hip pocket instead of straight up toward your shoulder.
